pages.title: Water in Crystals
pages.text: Managing water gives access to useful crystals.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Slugs drop slime; its block beside water crystallizes water. Silk Touch preserves mucus crystals; removing the source makes them decay. Brown mushrooms breed slugs.
